summary: The change adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. It also adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail readable by any logged-in user
findings.description: order_detail looks up the order by primary key alone. It never checks that the order belongs to request.user. Any logged-in user can read every other user's order totals and discount codes by changing the id in the URL. Filter the lookup by owner=request.user, as redeem and order_list already do.

findings.fix: Filter the lookup by owner=request.user, as redeem and order_list already do.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float raises TypeError
findings.description: apply_discount multiplies the Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError for Decimal times float. Every valid WELCOME10 redemption crashes with a server error, so the discount never applies. Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New model field has no migration
findings.description: The change adds discount_code to Order, but no migration adds the column. The only migration is orders/migrations/0001_initial.py, and it lacks discount_code. Every Order query, including the existing order_list, fails once deployed because the column is missing. Users get server errors on all order pages. Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on state-changing endpoint
findings.description: redeem changes the order total and discount code on a session-authenticated POST. The decorator turns off the CSRF check that the settings enable globally. A malicious site can make a logged-in user's browser redeem codes on that user's orders without consent. Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.title: New discount and endpoint behaviour has no tests
findings.description: The change adds apply_discount and two new views. The repository contains no test that exercises them. Nothing caught the Decimal crash or the missing owner check before review. Add tests for apply_discount, redeem and order_detail, including the cross-user access case.
